en.headline: Foreign elderly carers to earn 10-20pc more than helpers
en.dek: Chris Sun said a pilot next year would admit trained overseas carers with at least three years' elderly-care experience, modelled on the domestic helper regime.
body: Foreign domestic carers brought in to look after older people at home would be paid 10 to 20 per cent more than existing foreign domestic helpers under a pilot scheme due to start next year, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Friday.

The arrangement, announced in this week's Policy Address, would follow the existing system for admitting foreign domestic helpers. Applicants would need at least three years of experience in elderly care and certified training that the government intends to treat as broadly equivalent to the level of a health worker in a residential care home.

Sun said the scheme would give households a choice rather than replace the helper market. "If you only need a foreign domestic helper, then you continue to hire in the foreign domestic helper market," he said. "But if you need someone with high ability, who can be certified and can provide elderly care services, you can pay a bit more to hire a foreign domestic carer."

He said carers would still be able to carry out household duties such as cooking, and the government does not intend to set a quota for the pilot. The Labour Department has begun briefing consulates of major source countries and aims to work with the Immigration Department on implementation details later this year.

Sun added that existing helpers who wished to take up the new role would first have to return to their home countries for the required training. The details were released as the government published a report listing 73 measures to respond to an ageing society.

zh.headline: 外籍家居照顧員擬較外傭薪高一至兩成
zh.dek: 孫玉蕾表示，明年試行輸入具認可護老培訓及至少三年經驗的外籍家居照顧員，制度參照現有外傭安排。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉蕾周五表示，政府計劃明年試行輸入外籍家居照顧員，照顧居家長者，初步構思是其薪金下限較現時外籍家庭傭工高一成至兩成。
措施已在本周《施政報告》公布，制度會參照現有輸入外傭安排。申請人須具備至少三年照顧長者經驗，並在原居地接受經港府認可的培訓，水平擬等同院舍保健員。
孫玉蕾說，計劃是讓市民多一個選擇，而非取代外傭市場。他表示，若家庭只需一般外傭服務，可繼續在現有市場聘請；若需要較高護老能力的人員，則可多付一點薪酬聘用外籍家居照顧員。
他指，照顧員仍可負責煮飯等家務，目前不打算為計劃設限額。勞工處已向主要來源地駐港總領事館介紹初步構思，期望下半年聯同入境處擬定執行安排。
孫玉蕾又說，現時在港外傭若想轉任外籍家居照顧員，須先返回原居地完成培訓。政府同日發表應對社會高齡化對策報告，列出73項措施。
